Full Logistics & POS Suite

Engineered for scale and margin control

From small retail stores to sprawling multi-warehouse operations, AmbbaTech gives you total operational control over inventory, cashiers, and supplier replenishment.

Multi-Branch Warehouse Tracking

Live inventory visibility across your central warehouse, regional distribution hubs, and retail store branches.

Fast Barcode & SKU Scanning

Instant stock intake, stock takes, and cashier checkout using handheld wireless barcode and 2D QR scanners.

Automated Re-Order Par Levels

Configure minimum safety stock thresholds per item; the system automatically generates supplier purchase drafts.

Supplier POs & GRN Matching

Three-way matching between Purchase Orders, supplier delivery invoices, and Goods Received Notes (GRN).

Inter-Branch Stock Transfers

Formal dispatch notes, transfer requisitions, in-transit stock accounting, and receiving branch verification.

High-Volume Retail POS

Rapid touch & barcode cashier terminals supporting split payments, digital receipts, credit accounts, and loyalty.

Shrinkage & Loss Prevention

Spot-check cycle counts, damaged goods disposal workflows, and variance tracking against expected system balances.

FIFO & Weighted Stock Valuation

Accurate cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) calculations for accountants and tax auditors using validated inventory costing.

Role-Based Cashier Balancing

Blind float reconciliation, shift handover summaries, and multi-till discrepancy logs.

Executive Margin & Sales Telemetry

Hourly store revenue velocity, dead-stock warnings, highest-margin category breakdowns, and consolidated P&L.

The Store Management Workflow
